title: Life-Event Timeline
dataSources: Photos (`photo:capture`), places visited (`location:visit`), voice memos (`voicememo:note`), logged moments (`lifelog:moment`), timeline events (`timeline:event`).
app: Life-logging and memory telemetry — photo libraries (Google Photos, Immich), location history, voice memos, and daily-moment journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=timeline:event
| bin _time span=1y
| stats count as events, values(category) as categories by _time
| sort _time
description: Builds a year-by-year timeline of the milestones and events you have logged across your life.
value: A single timeline of your life's chapters is a treasure to look back on and to share with family.
implementation: Ingest milestone events into `index=personal`; group by year.
visualization: Timeline chart of life events by year.
grandmaExplanation: It lays out the big moments of your life year by year, a timeline you will treasure looking back on.
